newsitem.title: USA: Pa. plan to privatize liquor stores seen doubtful.
newsitem.headline: Pa. plan to privatize liquor stores seen doubtful.

text.p: Pennsylvania Gov. Tom Ridge's plan to close state-owned liquor stores and replace them with private franchises appeared in doubt this week, with lawmakers saying a vote this session was unlikely.
The month of May usually brings with it frantic budget talks, but this year the budget was signed into law last week several weeks ahead of the June 30 deadline.
While that's left lawmakers time to deal with other issues, the liquor store bill is not at the top of the agenda.
Ridge said his plan could have generated a net gain for the state of of $605 million through franchise fees and other revenue raisers.
